goal: Verify that a user can create a new account as the Site Host and successfully navigate the calendar to view the month of July 2026.

findings.instruction: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
findings.title: Dashboard layout is severely broken with overlapping and ghosted UI elements
findings.description: After successful sign-up and redirection to the dashboard, the UI is rendered in a corrupted state. Multiple UI layers (sidebar, calendar, feed) are overlapping, semi-transparent, and misaligned. The calendar appears duplicated and shifted, and the main feed content is obscured. This makes the application unusable.
findings.evidence: The 'AFTER' screenshot shows a chaotic layout where the sidebar icons are visible on the left, but the main content area has multiple overlapping instances of the calendar and feed sections. Text and controls are semi-transparent and layered on top of each other, indicating a critical rendering failure.
reproduction_steps: Enter 'alice' as the username and 'SecureP@ss123!' as the password.

findings.instruction: Once logged in and viewing the calendar for June 2026, click the 'Next month' button (indicated by a right arrow icon) to advance the calendar view.
findings.title: Calendar did not advance to July 2026 after clicking 'Next month'
findings.description: The instruction was to click the 'Next month' button to advance the calendar from June 2026 to July 2026. However, the calendar view in the 'AFTER' screenshot still displays 'June 2026', indicating the navigation action failed to update the state.
findings.evidence: In both the BEFORE and AFTER screenshots, the calendar header clearly reads 'June 2026'. The expected state change to 'July 2026' did not occur.
reproduction_steps: Navigate to the dashboard where the calendar is displayed.
Observe the calendar is set to 'June 2026'.
Click the 'Next month' button (right arrow icon).
Observe that the calendar remains on 'June 2026' instead of advancing to 'July 2026'.

findings.instruction: Click on the 'July 2026' button or header within the calendar interface to open the full year view and confirm the selection of July.
findings.title: Calendar view did not change after clicking 'July 2026' button
findings.description: The instruction was to click on the 'July 2026' button or header to open the full year view. However, comparing the BEFORE and AFTER screenshots, the calendar still displays 'June 2026' and the layout has not changed to a full year view. The action failed to produce the expected state change.
findings.evidence: In both the BEFORE and AFTER screenshots for Step 2, the calendar header clearly reads 'June 2026'. The grid layout remains a single-month view, not a full-year view as expected after the interaction.
reproduction_steps: Navigate to the calendar view showing June 2026.
Attempt to click on the 'July 2026' button or header to switch to the full year view.
Observe that the calendar remains on 'June 2026' and the view does not change.
